world.title: US court rules against Trump administration in California voting case
world.description: US appeals court blocks government effort to stop California from tabulating ballots from list of alleged non-citizens.

world.title: Changing Asia expo opens in Shenzhen
world.description: A photo exhibition on cultural and people-to-people exchanges in Asia opened in South China's Shenzhen on Monday, ahead of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, which the city is hosting next month.

world.title: Two months of prototyping turned good intentions into inclusive services
world.description: GovTech Singapore’s first inclusive challenge saw 17 prototypes built by public officers and students to tackle common accessibility challenges faced by people with disabilities, seniors and caregivers.

world.title: Judge blocks D.C. golf course tree removal, orders government to give notice before more changes
world.description: With hours to spare before her earlier order expired, U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes once again blocked the government from removing trees from East Potomac Park.

world.title: Singapore PM pledges continued support for workers amid job and cost pressures
world.description: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong reassures continuous government support for Singaporean workers facing rising costs and job uncertainties, emphasizing the need for adaptability and skills development.

world.title: The World Is Closer to Protecting 30 Percent of Its Land Than Official Figures Show, With One Catch
world.description: A Nature study estimates 26.8% of Earth’s land is already conserved, near the 30x30 goal, but the extra land misses many of the habitats at risk.

world.title: 'Red carpet' welcome for Trump questioned
world.description: MANILA, Philippines — Gabriela Women’s Party questioned why the Marcos administration was rolling out the red carpet for United States President Donald Trump during the upcoming Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, citing the reported flight cancellations and road disruptions Filipinos would face during his visit.

world.title: Is the Midwest about to turn on Donald Trump?
world.description: Farmers have been one of the US president’s most loyal constituencies. But now they are feeling the pinch, and are poised to deliver his party a harsh reality check.

business.description: A rash of similar cases where lawyers allegedly violated their client’s trust and misappropriated their money have ignited a debate in the legal profession

business.title: 'Meant to be in Perth': Flyer confused by new Sydney airport
business.description: One holiday-maker arriving in Sydney from Auckland quickly found out he had booked a ticket to the wrong place.

business.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
business.description: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

business.title: Japanese virtual desktop cloud hacked so hard it asks to be banned
business.description: CEO admits service used for foreign exchange trading had holes company was slow to fix

business.title: Netflix Hires Steve Wilson to Lead Podcast Content Acquisition
business.description: Netflix has hired Steve Wilson to head its podcast expansion.

business.title: Newspaper headlines: 'England's golden boy' and 'Time to pay fair'
business.description: Many of the papers consider what will be in the Budget and praise Harry Kane for his Ballon d'Or win.

business.title: Akbar's aiming to become best curry house in Bradford
business.description: Akbar's opened on Leeds Road in 1995 with 28 seats and has since grown into a 10-restaurant group without losing its focus on authentic Pakistani food.

business.title: The “influencer who doesn’t exist”: Social media platforms struggle to detect AI profiles
business.description: Both TikTok and Meta require AI-generated content to be labeled and have policies in place to take down videos that violate their respective community guidelines. However, WRAL Investigates found multiple videos still posted without proper labels.

science.title: False lingzhi unmasked: Scientists crack the 245-year mystery behind a medicinal mushroom mix-up
science.description: In a new study published today in Plants, People, Planet, scientists from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, and their international collaborators clarify the distinction between Ganoderma lucidum, a European bracket fungus described in 1781, and Ganoderma lingzhi, the East Asian species widely associated with medicinal lingzhi or reishi.

science.title: Semaglutide changes gut bacteria in rats beyond what eating less explains
science.description: Researchers compared semaglutide-treated male and female rats with pair-fed animals receiving the same amount and type of food to distinguish drug-associated microbiome changes from those linked to reduced eating. Semaglutide altered bacterial richness and community composition, with some changes absent from the pair-fed groups and uncertain consequences for health.

science.title: NMSU researcher’s team finds supermassive black holes may help form massive planets
science.description: NMSU astronomer Wladimir Lyra and collaborators found that disks around supermassive black holes may create massive planets, stars and black holes through a newly modeled formation process.

science.title: Fossils from brickworks reveal new dinosaur species that roamed England's wetlands 125 million years ago
science.description: More than 25 years after it was first discovered, a new species and genus of dinosaur have been named from the fossil collections cared for by the Natural History Museum. Paludohadros proudlovii was discovered at wienerberger's Ewhurst brick and roof tile works (Ewhurst Works) in Surrey in 2001 and subsequently donated to the Natural History Museum. It was a member of the iguanodontians—a group of dinosaurs known for their charismatic thumb spikes.

science.title: Paleontologists Reconstruct Cretaceous Bird in Remarkable Detail
science.description: Concornis lacustris, a small enantiornithine bird that lived alongside dinosaurs more than 100 million years ago, has received a life-size makeover, thanks to a reconstruction that combines fossil evidence, digital modeling and traditional sculpture.

science.title: 27 exoplanet targets for the world's first private space telescope
science.description: The Lazuli Space Telescope will be the first private space telescope. It's the brainchild of Eric Schmidt, Google's former CEO. It will have a 3-meter mirror (9.8 feet), larger than Hubble's 2.4-meter mirror (7.9 feet), and will be launched by 2029.

ai.title: Huayan Robotics to Present Smart Manufacturing and Embodied AI Applications at Robotworld 2026 in Korea
ai.description: GOYANG, South Korea, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Huayan Robotics will exhibit smart manufacturing solutions at Robotworld 2026 from November 4 to 7, 2026, at KINTEX in Goyang, South Korea (Hall 5, Booth I 05). The company will showcase welding, palletizing, and CNC machine tending solutions, alongside seven-axis humanoid robotic arms and core motion components for embodied AI technologies.

ai.description: Anthropic’s seven cofounders could each be worth up to $29 billion if the AI company goes public at a $2 trillion valuation, based on IPO filings and latest private funding rounds. AI stocks saw gains following the news.

ai.title: SBI launches CyRIS centre to strengthen cybersecurity capabilities
ai.description: SBI proudly introduces CyRIS, its new Cybersecurity Centre of Excellence, designed to elevate digital protection and competence. This centre will delve into vital aspects like threat intelligence, cyber defense mechanisms, and ethical hacking practices. It also emphasizes malware analysis, AI security, and quantum-safe advances, showcasing SBI's unwavering resolve to fortify cybersecurity across the financial landscape through collaborative efforts.

ai.description: Analysts believe the IPO could eclipse the record $86 billion raised by SpaceX.
